rules.check: Every changed operation-local branch or stored value outside bypass, fallback, compatibility, or migration paths is required by current behavior.

Every newly chosen implementation identifier uses descriptive full words for its domain concept, while reusable style keys name only the generic visual concept; established domain terms and names fixed by an explicit compatibility contract remain exact.
Changed class members follow repository visibility order.
Changed production implementation does not duplicate behavior already available from repository code.
Changed files contain no dead or commented-out implementation.
Every reused, shared, or domain-semantic literal in changed executable code is represented by one descriptively named constant; exact schema-required declarative keys and values are exempt.
Every changed `omni.ui` color literal uses AABBGGRR byte order.
Every changed public or protected class, function, method, and property has a Google-style docstring.
Every changed docstring accurately states its callable or type contract, including meaningful arguments, results, failures, ownership, and lifetime constraints.
Each changed inline comment about current implementation, except required test-structure or user-journey labels, states the reason, invariant, or constraint that makes it necessary.
Changed comments contain no development history, debugging breadcrumb, or intermediate-review narrative.
Every changed `# noqa` names the suppressed rule, is backed by evidence that the rule is wrong and no code change can satisfy it, and explains that constraint at the use site.
Each changed Python file has the SPDX Apache-2.0 header with the current year for a new file or its original creation year for an existing file; changed non-Python files have no Python header.
Every factual claim added to a comment or docstring is supported by current code or repository evidence.
